headline: YOUTUBE NOW PUTS A MODELLED GUESS AT HOW MANY PEOPLE WERE ON THE SOFA INSIDE THE PUBLIC VIEW COUNT, SO THE NUMBER ON YOUR BRAND FILM IS NO LONGER A COUNT OF PLAYS, AND IT IS THE SECOND TIME THE RULER HAS MOVED IN UNDER THREE MONTHS
deck: The view count is the one number everybody in this industry trusts without checking.  As of yesterday it contains an estimate.  If three people watch your film together on a television, that can now register as three views rather than one, worked out by a model whose method has not been published.  There is a way to back it out, and that way disappears in May 2027.
tldr: YouTube started including a modelled estimate of television co-viewers in public view counts on 16 November, so one play on a TV can now count as several views, and this is the second change to what a view means since 24 August.  Open Studio Insights, Advanced Mode, Device Type, read the co-view rate and divide your total views by it before you present any year-on-year comparison, and switch your headline brand channel metric to engaged views, which exclude co-views.

Amazon has told advertisers to expect impression counts about 63 percent lower from 1 January, because it will count an impression when the advert appears on the shopper's screen rather than when it starts downloading, while Google's 17 February change is a weaker one that will barely move its own number.  Send a short note now to whoever reads your media reporting explaining that the fall is a counting change and not a delivery change, that the two platforms are not making the same change, and move any dashboard or model that takes impressions as an input onto cost per acquisition and return on ad spend before the new year.

Jordan Brand's YouTube channel has 442,000 subscribers, a median of 8,851 views across its six uploads before this week, and an eight-minute Space Jam documentary on 457,155 views since Sunday, while an 18-minute upload from four months ago sits at 833, so length is not what is working and the channel's own organic reach is roughly three to twenty-one thousand.  Rank your own brand channel's last fifteen uploads by views, find the line where the numbers jump, check which ones above it had media spend, and plan against what is left underneath.

Twitch reported 2.44 times higher return on ad spend for Razer from its new skippable format, where the advertiser pays only if the viewer watches past 30 seconds, completes a shorter advert or clicks, which is about double Razer's previous Twitch results on standard video.  Run one December test of that format using a film you already have, so the only variable is the billing model, and keep pricing wins and creative wins in separate columns when you report it.

Stream Fighters 5 peaked at 2.59 million concurrent viewers on Saturday and held an average of 1.81 million across eight and a half hours, which is about 70 percent retention and better than the League of Legends final managed, yet its record hours-watched figure sits on top of a 36 percent fall in peak and no sponsor is named anywhere in the reporting.  Make average concurrents and airtime the first two questions you ask about any live sponsorship, and ask your agency what Spanish-language creator live events it has priced this year.

Disney will spend about 26 billion dollars on content in fiscal 2027, up 9 percent, and from December it starts carrying TikTok creator videos inside Disney Plus ahead of Avengers Doomsday on 18 December, which is the largest content buyer in the world saying that expensive library and cheap frequency are two different products.  Divide your own video budget into what gives people a reason to come and what gives them a reason to come back, and if the second pile is nearly empty move the cheapest tenth of the first into it.

The two creator items today point the same way: Selfie Leslie got a 130 percent launch-week revenue rise in the United States by paying a creator to design a collection rather than advertise one, and Just One More Watch, which lifted its median views from 59,822 to 95,477 by switching to ranked tier lists, gave Casio a 238,159-view launch-day hands-on for nothing, with no affiliate link and no sponsor copy anywhere in its description.  Buy something other than a post: write a design role into your next collaboration next to the posting deliverables, and where people shop by comparison, buy a named slot in the ranked-list format instead of a standalone review.
